title: Three Sales and a Scrawny Man

bible.title: Three Sales and a Scrawny Man
bible.kernel: An innkeeper hires mercenaries to bring back a payment and the man sold with it.

cast.name: Ildebad
cast.who: Roadside innkeeper who lost a midday payment and cannot cover his pledge.
cast.want: to recover a payment taken from him

cast.name: Enrith Rootward
cast.who: Forester-born raider who runs raids from a hidden camp and speaks bluntly.
cast.want: to keep the payment and the man bought with it

cast.name: Herve
cast.who: A scrawny, sickly entertainer who travelled with the bought payment and cannot stand for himself.

bible.situation: Ildebad's inn lost a payment taken by a courier. The payment passed through market hands and into a bandit band, and the buyer now claims both coin and a bound man sold with it.
bible.goal: to recover a payment taken from the client's purse
arc: Go to the ford the client named and question ferrymen and passing drivers about the night the money went missing → yields: word that a courier rode off to Dryhale Market and left a pawn-token with Tendris's stall

Find Tendris's stall at Dryhale Market and press him about the pawn-token the courier left there → yields: a brittle pawn-token naming Enrith Rootward as buyer and showing the bound man to be delivered again at the ford
Wait the meeting at the ford the client named, where Enrith comes to claim the sale. Beat Enrith, free Herve, take the payment, and hand it back to Ildebad while Herve chooses to join the company
tensions: Tendris will resell small pledges unless bought off or threatened
Enrith's raiders will fight for both coin and the captive
The road-keeper expects the pledged chest returned before the next rent day
openDirections: Dryhale Market's trade in pawned people and small debts may spawn new buyers or buyers' quarrels after the sale
bible.stakeIfLost: Ildebad's inn will be seized by the road-keeper when he cannot return the pledged chest.
bible.arrival: came behind a letter that said less · wanted it settled the same day

shipped.title: Question witnesses at Highwater Ford
shipped.situation: An innkeeper, Ildebad, came behind a letter that said less and wanted it settled the same day. He says that if the payment is not returned the road-keeper will seize Ildebad's inn. Go to Highwater Ford and question ferrymen and passing drivers about the night the money went missing, the coin comes at the finish, with the pick of what the job turns up. A brigand wants to keep the payment and the man bought with it. The man will not take the chair offered.
shipped.job: Ask ferrymen and passing drivers at Highwater Ford what they saw the night the payment vanished.
